Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Pupae <- read.csv("Kyn 072023/Kyn1pupation.csv")
HeightsTop<-Pupae%>%select("Vial","Treatment","Npupae","Top","Top.O.s","Top.X.s")
HeightsMid<-Pupae%>%select("Vial","Treatment","Npupae","Middle","Mid.O.s","Mid.X.s")
HeightsBot<-Pupae%>%select("Vial","Treatment","Npupae","Bottom","Bot.O.s","Bot.X.s")
```
Calulating Average Pupation Heights per vial
```{r}
HeightsTop[is.na(HeightsTop)] <- 0

HeightsTop%>%group_by(Treatment)%>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(Npupae),
    All = sum(Top),
    Male = sum(Top.O.s),
    Female = sum(Top.X.s),
    Height = 1.875,
    Level = factor(c("Top"))
  )-> HeightsTopAvg

# Replace NA with 0 in the data frame
HeightsMid[is.na(HeightsMid)] <- 0

HeightsMid%>%group_by(Treatment)%>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(Npupae),
    All = sum(Middle),
    Male = sum(Mid.O.s),
    Female = sum(Mid.X.s),
    Height = 1.125,
    Level = factor(c("Mid"))
  )-> HeightsMidAvg

# Replace NA with 0 in the data frame
HeightsBot[is.na(HeightsBot)] <- 0

HeightsBot%>%group_by(Treatment)%>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(Npupae),
    All = sum(Bottom),
    Male = sum(Bot.O.s),
    Female = sum(Bot.X.s),
    Height = .5,
    Level = factor(c("Bot"))
  )-> HeightsBotAvg

HeightsAvg<-rbind(HeightsTopAvg,HeightsMidAvg,HeightsBotAvg)
HeightsAvgM<-HeightsAvg%>%select(-"Female")
HeightsAvgM$Sex<-"Male"
HeightsAvgM <- HeightsAvgM %>%
  rename(Num = Male)
HeightsAvgF<-HeightsAvg%>%select(-"Male")
HeightsAvgF$Sex<-"Female"
HeightsAvgF <- HeightsAvgF %>%
  rename(Num = Female)
HeightsSex<-rbind(HeightsAvgF,HeightsAvgM)
```


```{r}
# Function to duplicate rows based on the "All" column
duplicate_rows <- function(df) {
  df[rep(seq_len(nrow(df)), df$All), ]
}

# Function to duplicate rows based on the "Male" column
duplicate_rows2 <- function(df) {
  df[rep(seq_len(nrow(df)), df$Num), ]
}

HeightsAvg<-duplicate_rows(HeightsAvg)
HeightsSex<-duplicate_rows2(HeightsSex)



summary_stats <- HeightsAvg %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Height = mean(Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Height = median(Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Height = sd(Height, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
Plotting
```{r}
# Create the violin plot
ggplot(HeightsAvg, aes(x = Treatment, y = Height, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, width = 0.8, show.legend = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.5, color="darkgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.5, 1.125, 1.875),
                     labels = c("bottom", "middle", "top"))+
  ylab("Pupal Height") +
  ggtitle("Pupal Height by Treatment, w[1118]") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple", "red", "mediumblue", "darkblue"))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        guide = guide_legend(fill = F)) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(HeightsAvgM, aes(x = Treatment, y = Height, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, width = 0.8, show.legend = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.5, color="darkgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.5, 1.125, 1.875),
                     labels = c("bottom", "middle", "top"))+
  ylab("Pupal Height") +
  ggtitle("Male Pupal Height by Treatment, w[1118]") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple", "red", "mediumblue", "darkblue"))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        guide = guide_legend(fill = F)) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(HeightsSex, aes(x = Sex, y = Height, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, width = 0.8, show.legend = F) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.5, color="darkgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.5, 1.125, 1.875),
                     labels = c("bottom", "middle", "top"))+
  facet_grid(~Treatment)+
  ylab("Pupal Height") +
  ggtitle("Female Pupal Height by Treatment, w[1118]") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple", "red", "mediumblue", "darkblue"))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        guide = guide_legend(fill = F)) +
  theme_classic()
```
ANOVAS
```{r}
# One-way ANOVA
anova_result <- summary(aov(Height ~ Treatment, data = HeightsAvg))
anova_result2 <- summary(aov(Height ~ Treatment*Sex, data = HeightsSex))

# Tukey's HSD post hoc test
posthoc_test <- TukeyHSD(aov(Height ~ Treatment, data = HeightsAvg))
posthoc_test2 <- TukeyHSD(aov(Height ~ Treatment*Sex, data = HeightsSex))

# View ANOVA results
print(anova_result)
print(anova_result2)

# View Tukey's HSD post hoc test results
print(posthoc_test)
print(posthoc_test2)


```
